================================================================================
type literal as method expression base
================================================================================

package main

var a = (*struct{ J }).M
var b = interface{ m1(string) }.m1
var c = struct{ J }.M
var d = (*interface{ M() }).M
var e = (**struct{ J }).M
var f = ((*struct{ J })).M(nil, 1)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (package_clause
    (package_identifier))
  (var_declaration
    (var_spec
      name: (identifier)
      value: (expression_list
        (selector_expression
          operand: (parenthesized_type
            (pointer_type
              (struct_type
                (field_declaration_list
                  (field_declaration
                    type: (type_identifier))))))
          field: (field_identifier)))))
  (var_declaration
    (var_spec
      name: (identifier)
      value: (expression_list
        (selector_expression
          operand: (interface_type
            (method_elem
              name: (field_identifier)
              parameters: (parameter_list
                (parameter_declaration
                  type: (type_identifier)))))
          field: (field_identifier)))))
  (var_declaration
    (var_spec
      name: (identifier)
      value: (expression_list
        (selector_expression
          operand: (struct_type
            (field_declaration_list
              (field_declaration
                type: (type_identifier))))
          field: (field_identifier)))))
  (var_declaration
    (var_spec
      name: (identifier)
      value: (expression_list
        (selector_expression
          operand: (parenthesized_type
            (pointer_type
              (interface_type
                (method_elem
                  name: (field_identifier)
                  parameters: (parameter_list)))))
          field: (field_identifier)))))
  (var_declaration
    (var_spec
      name: (identifier)
      value: (expression_list
        (selector_expression
          operand: (parenthesized_type
            (pointer_type
              (pointer_type
                (struct_type
                  (field_declaration_list
                    (field_declaration
                      type: (type_identifier)))))))
          field: (field_identifier)))))
  (var_declaration
    (var_spec
      name: (identifier)
      value: (expression_list
        (call_expression
          function: (selector_expression
            operand: (parenthesized_type
              (parenthesized_type
                (pointer_type
                  (struct_type
                    (field_declaration_list
                      (field_declaration
                        type: (type_identifier)))))))
            field: (field_identifier))
          arguments: (argument_list
            (nil)
            (int_literal)))))))

================================================================================
named method expressions keep the expression shape
================================================================================

package main

var a = (*T).M
var b = (T).M
var c = (*pkg.T[int]).M
var d = (struct{}{}).x

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (package_clause
    (package_identifier))
  (var_declaration
    (var_spec
      name: (identifier)
      value: (expression_list
        (selector_expression
          operand: (parenthesized_expression
            (unary_expression
              operand: (identifier)))
          field: (field_identifier)))))
  (var_declaration
    (var_spec
      name: (identifier)
      value: (expression_list
        (selector_expression
          operand: (parenthesized_expression
            (identifier))
          field: (field_identifier)))))
  (var_declaration
    (var_spec
      name: (identifier)
      value: (expression_list
        (selector_expression
          operand: (parenthesized_expression
            (unary_expression
              operand: (index_expression
                operand: (selector_expression
                  operand: (identifier)
                  field: (field_identifier))
                index: (identifier))))
          field: (field_identifier)))))
  (var_declaration
    (var_spec
      name: (identifier)
      value: (expression_list
        (selector_expression
          operand: (parenthesized_expression
            (composite_literal
              type: (struct_type
                (field_declaration_list))
              body: (literal_value)))
          field: (field_identifier))))))

================================================================================
parenthesized type literals stay conversions
================================================================================

package main

var a = (*interface{ M() })(nil)
var b = (*struct{ J })(nil)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (package_clause
    (package_identifier))
  (var_declaration
    (var_spec
      name: (identifier)
      value: (expression_list
        (type_conversion_expression
          type: (parenthesized_type
            (pointer_type
              (interface_type
                (method_elem
                  name: (field_identifier)
                  parameters: (parameter_list)))))
          operand: (nil)))))
  (var_declaration
    (var_spec
      name: (identifier)
      value: (expression_list
        (type_conversion_expression
          type: (parenthesized_type
            (pointer_type
              (struct_type
                (field_declaration_list
                  (field_declaration
                    type: (type_identifier))))))
          operand: (nil))))))
